notes: Airbnb is an online marketplace, not a room operator; it owns no rooms and reports no ADR, RevPAR or occupancy as an operator.

lodging_operating_format.value: Online marketplace for vacation rentals, homes, some hotels, plus experiences and services; not a hotel operator

room_inventory_ownership_scope.value: No owned or managed rooms; large listing inventory of host-supplied vacation rentals across many countries

ownership_management_franchising.value: Third-party hosts own and list properties; Airbnb operates the platform and neither owns, manages nor franchises them

hotel_demand_seasonality.value: Leisure travel demand across destinations, including ski and mountain getaways, city trips and monthly rentals

brand_fee_contract_economics_asset_light.value: Asset-light marketplace taking service fees on bookings; services hosts pay a fee deducted from each payout
